message:
fix(dlss): preserve promoted padding and validate production FP16 composites

Share production RGBA/RGB shaders with an asset-free Vulkan raster fixture.
Keep fallback RGBA outside the NGX scratch content extent rather than
overwriting padded target pixels with out-of-range scratch loads.
The fixture checks RGB, guest alpha and padding in FP16 without invoking NGX.
No in-game SR or Gate 3 acceptance is claimed.
